Room code — you and your friend must type the exact same one:
1 vs 1: first to join becomes Player 1, second Player 2. Team modes: everyone who types the same code and picks the same format takes the next free seat; empty seats are Bots. Test-mode rules are open to anyone with the URL — don't store anything sensitive.
Tap a hexagon to change your gear.
🤼 Team Mode — pick a format
🤼 Team setup — set gear for every pawn. To change a spawn: tap a pawn on the board, then tap an empty cell.
🧪 Simulation — pick a loadout for both pawns, then watch two AIs fight it out.
Tip: click your own pawn to pick Move. Wait (+1 SP) → Rest (+2) or Heal ½ → Nap (+3) or Heal (+1 HP, costs max HP); an unfinished turn auto-fills Wait · Rest · Nap. Repeat Defend/Dodge for cheaper, bigger versions (Defend ×2/×3, chained Dodges). Defend → Dash (shield-dodge that can ram) or Defend → Counter-Defend (Sword+Shield: the shield cells redirect, your own cell counters ×2); Dodge → Counter (yellow cells catch a blow, the red redirection cell sends it back ×2 and staggers; a Counter right after a Dodge/Counter also traps blows early, and counters can be bounced back and forth). 🌋 Berserk: Wait / Rest / Nap / Heal are one Enrage button. 🧙 Mage: 🌌 Spellcraft opens the spell book (pick a Fundamental, tap the recipe box, cast the spell); Undo takes a crafting step back.
